name: eternal-client
description: Eternal Client — a real Minecraft launcher and standalone in-game client.
author: Eternal Client

scripts.dev: npm run brand:prepare && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.test:runtime: node --input-type=module -e "import updaterPackage from 'electron-updater'; if (!updaterPackage || typeof updaterPackage !== 'object' || !('autoUpdater' in updaterPackage)) throw new Error('electron-updater autoUpdater export unavailable');"
scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build
